tagline: We create value for people and society by building strong and sustainable businesses
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted NAV is the primary performance indicator for Investor AB, reflecting the adjusted value of its net assets and capturing the essence of its long-term holding strategy. It is the key driver of shareholder value creation.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Asset Value
kpis.explanation: Total adjusted net asset value of the company, key for a holding company like Investor.
kpis.description: Adjusted NAV stands at 1,125.1 billion SEK as of March 31, 2026, up 3% for the quarter.

kpis.name: Total Shareholder Return
kpis.explanation: Total shareholder performance, including share price appreciation and dividends.
kpis.description: Total return stands at 7% for the quarter, versus -1% for the SIXRX index.

kpis.name: Consolidated Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total consolidated revenues from all operational subsidiaries.
kpis.description: 16.1 billion SEK in consolidated sales in Q1 2026, compared to 15.99 billion SEK a year earlier.

kpis.name: Consolidated Profit
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net income, including valuation changes in participations.
kpis.description: Swing from a loss of 3.0 billion SEK to a profit of 30.1 billion SEK, driven by asset valuation gains.
kpis.signal: Very high profit versus prior year loss.

kpis.name: Leverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Net debt ratio relative to asset value, indicating financial prudence.
kpis.description: Leverage stands at 1.2% as of March 31, 2026, down from 2.1% at end of 2025.
kpis.signal: Very low debt, reinforcing financial flexibility.

kpis.name: Dividend Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Recurring cash flow from dividends paid by listed portfolio companies.
kpis.description: Expected ordinary dividends of 14.4 billion SEK, up 2% versus prior year.
kpis.signal: Key cash source for strategic deployment.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 1,102.81 billion € in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 115.31 billion € in latest year

kpis.name: Organic Sales Growth (Patricia Industries)
kpis.explanation: Sales growth excluding currency and acquisition effects for major Patricia Industries subsidiaries.
kpis.description: Sales of major Patricia subsidiaries declined 7% on a reported basis, but grew 3% on an organic basis in constant currency.
kpis.signal: Positive organic growth despite reported decline.

kpis.name: Organic Growth Mölnlycke
kpis.explanation: Organic sales growth for Mölnlycke, flagship subsidiary of Patricia Industries, in constant currency.
kpis.description: Mölnlycke shows organic growth of 3% in constant currency, supported across all divisions with the Wound Care unit growing 2%.
kpis.signal: Solid performance in wound care and related divisions.

ai_positioning.summary: Investor emphasizes the strategic importance of AI as a key value creation lever. The company is actively investing in AI adoption across its portfolio and recognizes significant untapped potential. Concrete examples include the use of generative AI in fraud prevention (Verafin/Nasdaq) and network optimization at Ericsson.
evidence: CEO statement: 'Focus on the implementation of value-creating AI remains high' and 'including AI, the green transition, and geographic expansion, to drive value creation'
Nasdaq/Verafin: 'uses agentic AI to improve productivity for customers, transforming the fight against fraud and money laundering'
Ericsson: 'By applying AI in network planning and optimization, helps improve customers' capital efficiency and return on investment'
CEO acknowledges that 'the untapped potential remains significant' despite advances
